title: applied-ml-experiment-scratchpad-2026-03-19-jordan
content:
Quick log / scratchpad for today's applied-ml experiments (short form).

Context: running evals for conversational summarization workload to compare base fp16 vs q4_0 vs nf4-q4_1 on A100 and H100 pools. Goal: find quantization profile that preserves ROUGE/LM-clarity while reducing GPU memory/latency. Also testing prompt variants for instruction-following degradation after quantization.

Runs executed:
- run 2026-03-19-01: model: redwood-mmix-13b (fp16) on pool-a100-xlarge; dataset: convo-summ-v2 (dev split 1k); batch_size=8; seq_len=1024; notes: baseline.
- run 2026-03-19-02: model: redwood-mmix-13b (q4_0) on pool-a100-xlarge; otherwise same; result: avg latency +6% vs fp16, memory -38%, rouge1 delta -0.7 (small), hallucination rate slightly higher (manual spot-check).
- run 2026-03-19-03: model: redwood-mmix-13b (nf4-q4_1) on pool-h100-medium; batch_size=12; result: latency -12% vs fp16, mem -52%, rouge1 delta -0.3, but some failures on long prompts (>1800 tokens) due to kv-cache mismatch in runtime (see next).
- run 2026-03-19-04: model: redwood-mmix-13b (q2_kv/experimental) — aborted (OOM > investigate quant config).

Prompt sets tested (abbrev):
- baseline_prompt_v1: "Summarize the conversation focusing on action items and decisions." (unchanged)
- instructive_prompt_v2: add explicit examples + formatting constraints (bullet list output)
- conservative_prompt_v3: force shorter summaries (max_tokens=150)
Notes: q4_0 had more tendency to truncate/omit low-salience details on v2; v3 reduced hallucinations but ROUGE dropped. Need to tune temperature/presence_penalty for q-profiles.

Quick metrics (dev-1k subset, rough):
- fp16 baseline: ROUGE-1: 42.6, ROUGE-L: 37.1, avg latency per request: 420ms
- q4_0: ROUGE-1: 41.9, ROUGE-L: 36.6, avg latency: 445ms
- nf4-q4_1 (H100): ROUGE-1: 42.3, ROUGE-L: 36.9, avg latency: 370ms
- Notes: numbers noisy; need +/-95% CI and more runs.

Bugs / anomalies:
- KV cache mismatch on H100 with nf4-q4_1 for sequences > 1800 tokens. Stack traces point to kernel selection fallback — filed github PR reference above. Repro script: experiments/repro/kv_mismatch_repro.py (local).
- Occasional tokenization differences between fp16 and quantized runner (possible tokenizer config mismatch) — check tokenizer.json versions and special tokens mapping.

To-dos (short):
- [ ] Run full dev(5k) eval for nf4-q4_1 on H100 to reduce noise (priority).
- [ ] Add CI eval job for convo-summ baseline + q4_0 nightly (small sample) — coordinate with CI infra (cc @Asha).
- [ ] Investigate kv-cache mismatch: add unit test, log raw kv lengths per layer. Link to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtimes/pull/342
- [ ] Sweep temp and presence_penalty for q4 profiles (grid: temp=[0.0,0.2,0.5], presence=[0,0.6]) and record ROUGE+manual hallucination checks.
- [ ] Confirm tokenizer version pinned in model registry for redwood-mmix-13b (registry entry id: MMIX-13B-v1)

Notes to self / scratches:
- Try smaller microbatch + larger batch_size for q4 to see throughput sweet spot.
- If nf4-q4_1 continues to show kv issues, fallback policy in runtime should route long sequences to fp16 automatically (policy idea: if seq_len > 1600 -> route to fp16/H100 pool). Ops ticket maybe needed.
- Remember to update product-facing eval doc (confluence) if we decide to recommend nf4 profile for convo-summ.

Meeting reminders:
- Sync w/ infra on 2026-03-20 10:00 (Asha, Maya) to discuss H100 pool setup and CI scheduling.
- Quick review with product on 2026-03-21 (15 min) to show perf tradeoffs for Dedicated customers.

Links:
- repro script: /home/jordan/repos/ri/experiments/convo_summ/repro_kv.py
- notes + plots (temp): https://s3.redwood.ai/experiments/convo-summ/2026-03-19/plots.zip

End of scratchpad for 2026-03-19 — will tidy results and push selected runs to confluence after full dev-5k completes.
